fields.reasoning: The intent says Home shows every inbox item, and this plan retires web-overview-inbox, so anything Home omits that the Overview shows today is a regression: permission-blocked sessions, runs the daemon gave up on, open items and API errors would vanish from the web. webInboxKinds (internal/api/web_inbox.go:10) already defines and renders that set owner-safe (webInboxViews), so reusing it is the smallest change that keeps parity. Extending to every CLI inbox kind (blocker, overlap, accept, skipped, interview, workflow, guide-stale…) would widen scope beyond the at-a-glance goal and add kinds with no web rendering yet; webInboxKinds' own comment records the choice that those stay in the CLI, so 'every inbox item' is read as every item the web inbox carries.
fields.statement: Home's needs-you list covers at least every inbox kind today's web Overview lists (webInboxKinds: question, open, sign-off, failed, gave-up, stalled/stuck, permission, api-error) plus holds, each with its reason in words and only the safe actions that apply; the web-home-needs-you leaf and its acceptance are widened to name these kinds with a fixture each. Inbox kinds the web Overview leaves to the CLI today (blocker, overlap, skipped, accept and the like) stay out of Home in this change set.
